name: The Choices Of Priori
storyline: The story begins in a city called "Overtime City", you play as a frail teenager, starting from an empty room, uncover a mysterious black cloth, you explore a vast underground lab, and find strange creatures called KB-Cats, they plot a revolutionary uprising, with them you finally reach to the "Path to freedom". In this forever daytime world, you’ll meet many vivid companions. Together, you’ll think and explore the theme” work or die”, with their help, you’ll make your choices, chase the truth and survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.
summary: You wake in an empty room, condemned to endless work—until uncovering a mysterious black cloth, you find a vast underground lab, a group of strange creatures called KB-Cats are plotting a revolution there. Join their uprising, survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.
